question: How long does an internal referral take?

output.question: How long does an internal referral take?

context.section: Target completed-referral time: 11 days from creation to confirmed
context.text:
Target completed-referral time: 11 days from creation to confirmed
appointment (this is the company's current average, which it is trying to
reduce — not a published service commitment to patients).

context.section: If a patient hasn't received appointment options within 5 business days...
context.text:
If a patient hasn't received appointment options within 5 business days of
the referral being created, the coordinator must escalate the case directly
to Marcus Reid (Director of Clinical Operations).

context.section: Referrals to specialists outside the HealthCore network do not follow th...
context.text:
Referrals to specialists outside the HealthCore network do not follow this

output.answer: An internal referral at HealthCore typically takes 11 days from the creation of the referral to when the appointment is confirmed. If a patient hasn't received appointment options within 5 business days, the case should be escalated to Marcus Reid (Director of Clinical Operations). Referrals to specialists outside our network are handled manually and can take longer.
